data.name: JIM_LDAP_Connector_ConnectorDescription
data.value: Enables bi-directional synchronization with LDAP compliant directories, including Microsoft Active Directory, OpenLDAP, and Samba AD.

data.name: JIM_LDAP_Connector_Manage_Exchange_recipients_Description
data.value: Active Directory only. Makes the objects this Connected System provisions Exchange recipients (mailboxes, mail users, mail contacts and mail-enabled groups), as declared by the Exchange attributes their Synchronization Rules flow.

data.name: JIM_File_Connector_ConnectorDescription
data.value: Enables bi-directional synchronization with files, i.e. CSV.

data.name: JIM_SCIM_2_0_Client_Connector_ConnectorDescription
data.value: Enables bi-directional synchronization with any system that exposes a SCIM 2.0 service provider interface. JIM acts as the SCIM client, connecting out to the service provider.

data.name: JIM_SCIM_2_0_Client_Connector_Retry_Delay_ms_Description
data.value: Initial delay between retries in milliseconds. Uses exponential backoff with jitter, and honors Retry-After response headers. Default is 1000ms.

data.name: JIM_SQL_Connector_ConnectorDescription
data.value: Enables bi-directional synchronization with relational databases, including Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle Database.

data.name: JIM_SQL_Connector_Treat_RAW_16_Columns_as_Guid_Description
data.value: Oracle Database holds GUIDs in RAW(16) columns, but so it does digests and other binary values, and the catalog cannot tell them apart. Turn this on if RAW(16) columns in this database hold GUIDs; leave it off and they import as binary values.

data.name: JIM_Microsoft_Entra_ID_Connector_ConnectorDescription
data.value: Enables bi-directional synchronization of users and groups with Microsoft Entra ID, through the Microsoft Graph API.

data.name: JIM_Microsoft_Entra_ID_Connector_Microsoft_Entra_ID_Tenant_Info_Description
data.value: Enter the details of the tenant to synchronize with, and of the app registration JIM authenticates as. The app registration needs Microsoft Graph application permissions, granted with admin consent.

data.name: JIM_Microsoft_Entra_ID_Connector_Track_Source_of_Authority_Changes_Description
data.value: Whether to read, for each object synchronized from Active Directory, whether its Source of Authority has been switched to Entra ID, or switched back, so sourceOfAuthority shows where it is managed now. Turn it on in a hybrid tenant whose objects have their Source of Authority switched. It needs the User-OnPremisesSyncBehavior.ReadWrite.All and Group-OnPremisesSyncBehavior.ReadWrite.All permissions, the only ones Microsoft offers for reading it, which also allow changing it. Off, an object synchronized from Active Directory always reads as onPremisesDirectory.
